metaDescription: Indicative pricing for mould remediation in Gatineau, Ottawa and Quebec City, including pricing factors, inclusions and next steps.

hero.title: Mould remediation pricing
hero.body: We do not publish fixed mould prices because a file can change quickly depending on the affected area, the source of the issue, site access and the level of containment required.

overview.title: Before comparing prices
overview.body: Mould remediation is not limited to removing a visible stain. Pricing often depends on what is happening behind the materials, the remaining moisture, the surfaces that must be removed and the level of protection required to avoid spread.

pricing.title: How we frame the budget
pricing.intro: For mould files, we work with estimates based on evaluation rather than posted flat pricing. A small visible area, contamination behind walls, or a file after water damage do not require the same level of intervention.

cards.title: Targeted intervention on a small area
details: Light to moderate containment depending on the file

cards.title: Heavier or more widespread file
details: Spread across several rooms or cavities
Scope to be confirmed after inspection

notes: Final budgeting varies depending on the number of affected areas, residual moisture, materials to remove and overall site logistics.
Photos, a visit or sampling may be required to confirm the right approach before quoting the file.

items.title: Surface area and depth of the issue
items.body: A small visible area does not carry the same pricing as contamination spreading behind walls, inside a ceiling, a basement or an attic.

items.title: Moisture source to address
items.body: Infiltration, water damage, condensation or poor ventilation can change the actual scope of work and the measures required.

items.title: Containment and access
items.body: Site access, occupancy and the required level of containment have a direct effect on labour time and pricing.

included.title: What may be included depending on the file
items: Reading of the issue and affected area
Cleaning and sanitation of retained surfaces

cta.title: Need a more accurate price?
cta.body: Send us photos, the address and a short description of the issue. We can point you to the next useful step or prepare a quote.
